scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n vite,electron,server "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron electron/main.cjs" "..\backend\venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ..\backend --reload-dir ..\backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n vite,server "cross-env VITE_APP_PLATFORM=web vite" "..\backend\venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ..\backend --reload-dir ..\backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.build:web: tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_PLATFORM=web VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 vite build
